root_cause.explanation: The exam-time paper (paper_questions / LivePaperQuestionSerializer) sends no question type and paperQuestionFromJson sets none, so classifyType returns UNKNOWN and extractStructure never runs.

fix.recipe: Backend: add question_type to the exam paper payload. App: read it in paperQuestionFromJson and pass it to LiveQuestion.questionType. Regression test: a MATCH paper item renders a two-column table on the live exam.

title: Image-only options render as empty tiles on the live exam

root_cause.explanation: LivePaperQuestionSerializer keeps each option image, but paperQuestionFromJson keeps only id and text, and QuestionWebView never draws option images.

fix.recipe: Carry option image through LiveQuestion -> Question -> RawOption and render it inside .otext; regression test with an image-only option.
fix.workaround_for_old_builds: Data: set the option text to (plus any text).

occurrences.resolution: found by code reading; confirm on the next paper with option images

title: Markdown bold and images show literally

root_cause.explanation: The importer emits markdown; the app renderer has no markdown support, and linkifyImageUrls skips URLs inside ](...).

fix.recipe: **x** -> x; ![alt](u) -> . Stop the importer emitting markdown.

occurrences.resolution: fixed in data before the test

title: Degree sign after a thin space fails to parse

root_cause.explanation: KaTeX rejects a superscript after \, (no base). The app repairs it in normalize (fixMathSpacingScripts) since 2026-06.

fix.recipe: Inside math, \,^ -> \,{}^ . A hit on a current pin means a variant the app repair does not cover: extend fixMathSpacingScripts.
fix.workaround_for_old_builds: Apply the data transform for builds older than the repair.

title: Pre-rendered KaTeX HTML collapses (superscripts drop, fractions overlap)

root_cause.explanation: Stems store KaTeX output instead of TeX; the sanitizer strips its inline styles. The app de-bakes blocks that keep <annotation encoding="application/x-tex">; blocks without it keep only text.

fix.recipe: Replace each surviving .katex block with $TEX$ (TeX from the source paper when there is no annotation). Importer: never store rendered KaTeX.

occurrences.resolution: fixed in app (debake) for annotated blocks

title: Side-by-side match columns built with flex divs collapse

root_cause.explanation: The importer laid out match columns with style="display:flex"; the app sanitizer drops every style attribute, so the columns run together.

fix.recipe: Rewrite the flex container as <table> with one row per pair; fix the importer template.

occurrences.resolution: fixed in data before the test

root_cause.explanation: u is not in the app sanitizer allowlist, so it is unwrapped and the emphasis is lost.

fix.recipe: X -> X. App option: add u to the allowlist with a regression test.

title: Bare image URL with an upper-case extension or a query string is not shown

root_cause.explanation: linkifyImageUrls only matches lower-case extensions and stops at the extension, so FIG.PNG stays text and fig.png?sig=... leaves the query as text.

fix.recipe: Store or move the URL to the image column. App option: case-insensitive match and allow a query string.

title: Very tall question loses its bottom (last options) to the height clamp

root_cause.explanation: QuestionWebView caps the platform-view height at 8000 physical px (about 2666 CSS px at DPR 3) to stay under the GPU texture limit.

fix.recipe: Downscale or crop tall images, split long passages. App option needs a device test against the texture limit.

title: Subscripts, superscripts and images inside match cells are stripped

root_cause.explanation: Structure extraction passes match cells and A/R text through _stripTags before stemToHtml rebuilds them.

fix.recipe: Keep inline tags when extracting cells; regression test with <sub> in a cell.
fix.workaround_for_old_builds: Use $\ce{H2O}$ / $x^{2}$ math instead of <sub>/<sup> inside cells.
